validity.researcher_notes: P7835 Cougar Lateral (55 mi, 42 in) is a real, FID-stage segment of the Mustang Express Pipeline. EIA (Aug 2026), ARM Energy announcement (10/9/2025), and Houston Chronicle (10/13/2025) all confirm existence, ownership (Arm Energy Holdings + PIMCO), diameter, length, and $2.3B system investment. FID announced 10/9/2025; in-service target late 2028/early 2029. The three segments (55-mile Cougar Lateral, 178-mile Mainline, 3-mile Golden Triangle Storage Lateral) total 236 miles with 2,500 MMcf/d system capacity. No segment-specific capacity or construction start date announced yet. Status remains 'proposed' pending construction commencement.
